claim_ceiling: Dense multilingual-e5 embeddings validated as COMPLEMENTARY modes only: (1) Citation heritage recovery AUC 0.79-0.85 > TF-IDF 0.71-0.74 at 21-22yr scale; (2) Section cross-lingual Sachverhalt (0.282) and Dispositiv (0.150) pass thresholds, Erwaegungen (0.094) fails; (3) Linear hybrids pass adversarial gates at 19yr+ (w=0.3-0.4) but remain BELOW TF-IDF baseline (JP 0.61-0.67 vs 0.78-0.79). Dense embeddings FAIL jurist gate at ALL scales (JP 0.05-0.43). True OOS JuristPref ceiling ~0.53 < 0.7 factory target. TF-IDF citation hybrids = PRIMARY product mode. Data blocker (bge_/bger_ ID mapping + missing parquet 2022-2026) requires corpus lane resumption.
